# FDG3019

> DO use a name similar to the old API when creating new versions of an existing API.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.2.4 Naming New Versions of Existing APIs.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application none, test none
- Status: verified

Versioning guideline: applies to the library profile only.

## From the book

This helps to highlight the relationship between the APIs.

```csharp
class AppDomain {
   [Obsolete("AppDomain.SetCachePath has been deprecated. Please use
AppDomainSetup.CachePath instead.")]
   public void SetCachePath(String path) { ... }
}

class AppDomainSetup {
   public string CachePath { get { ... }; set  { ... }; }
}
```
